The *Bahujanahita Sutta* ("For the Welfare of the People", Iti 84) is a discourse found in the third section of the *Itivuttaka* (It 3.35, PTS It 78). The text expounds upon three types of persons who appear in the world for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of the people.
